# apple_beta_groups (Data Source)

Lists the beta groups that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_beta_groups" "external" {
  app_id   = data.apple_app.example.id
  internal = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Only groups of this app.
- `internal` (Boolean) Only internal groups, or only external groups.
- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.

### Read-Only

- `beta_groups` (Attributes List) The matching groups, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--beta_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--beta_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `beta_groups`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the beta group.
- `internal` (Boolean) Whether the group is for internal testers.
- `name` (String) Name of the group.
- `public_link` (String) The public link, when enabled.
- `public_link_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the public link is enabled.
